The work behind the notes

Building systems.
Sharing experience.

In my role as Principal Data Architect, I technically lead a team of 100+ data and platform engineers in shaping our data architecture. I combine strategic guidance with technical stewardship to improve scalability, agility and innovation, working with business leaders to align technology with corporate goals.

My focus is on high-performance data platforms, large-scale streaming and decentralised architectures guided by Data Contracts and Data Mesh. Across the Schwarz Group, I work on federated, self-service capabilities and engineering standards for ingestion, modelling and data consumption.

I’m also designing and deploying agentic architectures on top of data platforms: conversational analytics through semantic layers, LangGraph agents and multi-agent orchestration. I lead both the strategy and implementation of these systems, while continually researching emerging technologies and architectural methods. My earlier work in natural language processing and time-series forecasting informs this work.

My commitment to technical excellence and the community led to 10 consecutive years as a Microsoft Data Platform MVP. Teaching remains part of that journey, through conferences, training and this blog. Over my career, I’ve led more than 150 projects across countries including Spain, Germany, the USA, the United Arab Emirates, the Netherlands, Mexico, Saudi Arabia and Austria.

Part of the journey

I also co-founded Cloud Data Ninjas. The project is no longer maintained, but remains part of my professional history.

Continually researching emerging technologies and architectural methods. My current exploration focuses on semantic layers, multi-agent systems and advanced Data Mesh.

Full biography

Enrique Catalá is a Computer Engineer and Executive Professional, currently Principal Data Architect shaping a platform with over 100 million users within Europe’s leading retail group. He works at SCRM International Lidl Hub / Schwarz Global Services Barcelona. With more than 20 years in the data platform space, he provides technical leadership to over 100 data and platform engineers. He combines strategic guidance and technical stewardship, working with business leaders to align technology with corporate goals. His work covers scalable data platforms, large-scale streaming, Data Contracts and federated architectures guided by Data Mesh principles. He establishes engineering standards for ingestion, modelling and consumption, and researches emerging technologies and architectural methods. He also designs agentic systems using LangGraph, semantic layers and multi-agent orchestration to enable conversational analytics. A Microsoft Data Platform MVP for 10 consecutive years, Enrique shares his experience through conferences, training and technical writing. His background includes over 150 international projects and co-founding Cloud Data Ninjas, a project that is no longer maintained.
